events.event: Binance disclosed that North Korea-linked hackers used a fake job interview and a malware-laced test file to compromise an engineer, after months of preparation, before the 29 October heist.
events.key_numbers: Binance puts theft at about US$6.6 billion (Chainalysis: about US$6.4 billion; earlier reports US$6.3 billion) · attack lasted about 4 hours on 29 Oct · hackers active since June · fake interview in September · further access 20 Oct, 9 days before the attack · Binance says 98% of affected assets replaced from own funds · about one-third frozen (Chainalysis: about US$2.8 billion frozen as of 3 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: A fake job offer on a job platform was the entry point, a trick that can target anyone who works with company systems.
events.spreading_evidence: Reported by ABC, CNN, PBS, Japan Times; Indonesian outlets covered the OJK reaction

events.event: Komdigi said the draft presidential regulation (Perpres) creating the personal data protection (PDP) supervisory body is in its final stage and has been submitted to the President via Setneg.
events.key_numbers: UU PDP No. 27/2022 mandated the body; still not established 4 years later · target set for 2026 · body to report to the President through Komdigi (Nezar Patria, 21 Jul)
events.why_it_matters: Data leaks keep happening (Fore, 5.7 million accounts) while the agency meant to punish them still does not exist.
events.spreading_evidence: Tied to the DPR reaction over the presidential wiretap story on CNBC Indonesia tech

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta smart glasses go on sale in Indonesia on 11 November, with a security expert warning they can record people without their knowledge.
events.key_numbers: From Rp8 juta · on sale 11 Nov 2026 · models: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 (Wayfarer, Aviator, Zena), Oakley Meta (HSTN, Vanguard) · recording signalled only by a small LED
events.why_it_matters: Anyone nearby can be filmed in public places with no clear Indonesian rule on it.

events.event: After Democratic wins in the US midterms on opposition to data centres, AI data-centre and power stocks fell and Goldman Sachs estimated a freeze on a large share of planned US data-centre expansion.
events.key_numbers: Goldman Sachs: about 45% of planned new US data-centre capacity expansion could freeze · 4 Nov: Core Scientific -11.6%, IREN -12.5% · TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix, Kioxia also fell in Asia · Texas about a quarter of projected US data-centre capacity
events.why_it_matters: The AI data-centre boom, including Indonesian projects like Jakarta and Cikarang, depends on chips and capital that react to US politics.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC Indonesia tech headlines plus detikInet business (5 Nov)

events.event: Meta, Google and TikTok sued California's attorney general over AB 1709, which bans autoplay and personalised recommendations for under-16s, while CNBC Indonesia compared it with Indonesia's PP Tunas.
events.key_numbers: Fine up to US$50,000 (about Rp750 juta) per affected child · California law takes effect early 2027 · Indonesia: PP 17/2025 (PP Tunas), Komdigi Permen 9/2026, under-16 social media ban from 28 Mar 2026 · age tiers: under 13, 13-15, 16-17, 18+
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia's age limit for kids on social media is being copied abroad and fought by the same platforms.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC Indonesia tech headlines on 6 Nov

events.event: CNBC Indonesia published a how-to for checking a household's desil (socioeconomic decile) with NIK on the Kemensos and BPS sites, which decides bansos eligibility.
events.key_numbers: 10 desil groups · 39 socioeconomic variables · desil 1-5 poor to near-middle class, 6-10 middle to upper · sites: cekbansos.kemensos.go.id, dtsen-form.bps.go.id
events.why_it_matters: Your desil can decide whether you get bansos, and you can check it yourself in two minutes.
events.spreading_evidence: Fresh CNBC Indonesia tech item, 6 Nov; Perlinsos Digital launch is 10 Nov (E0208)

events.event: NASA's Swift space telescope re-entered the atmosphere over northern Sumatra and burned up, with no damage reported.
events.key_numbers: 1,450 kg · launched Nov 2004 for a 2-year mission, ran 22 years · about 7,000 papers · re-entry about 19.39 WIB (Wednesday) at about 22 times the speed of sound · August 2026 reboost attempt by Katalyst failed
events.why_it_matters: A 1.4-tonne satellite fell over Indonesian airspace; the date is inferred as 4 Nov from 'Wednesday'.
